verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a hardware security key vendor, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows standards-based use: FIDO CTAP1 compatibility and sign-in through Google apps and browsers. A runtime probe explicitly states that Titan ships no vendor CLI, SDK, or API of its own. Support for the open FIDO standard is a building block developers could use, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs let me integrate the key into my own desktop and mobile apps
